gadget_variants.effect: Deploying Gloo Wall grants EP, in-match currency, or consumables. Low chance to drop Active Skill Cards or Horizalines.
Deals +50% extra DMG to enemy Gloo Walls. Destroying a Gloo Wall triggers an explosion dealing 38 DMG to enemies within range.
Scans enemies within 35m for 6 seconds upon Gloo Wall deployment. Marks enemies within 10m for 2 seconds.
Gloo Wall gains +250 extra durability. If player is knocked down, automatically deploys a Gloo Wall with 150 durability towards the incoming shot after an 8.6s delay (Disabled in Solo Mode).
